description: ACTGOV Smart Parking Transmitter Assets is a dataset listed in ACT Government open data portal (www.data.act.gov.au), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by ACT Government. This point dataset shows the locations of Smart Parking Transmitters in the Australian Capital Territory. These assets are either owned or managed by City Services, City and Environment Directorate (CED). Coverage: Australian Capital Territory. The table has 16 columns. The portal shows 2026-04-06 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-act-gov-au-portal.
